artworks.title: Riva degli Schiavone, No. 1
artworks.medium: etching and roulette in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: This image depicts a busy port scene observed from an elevated angle. The quay is shown with people engaged in various activities on the cobblestone surface. Several ships are docked along the water, and buildings line the horizon, suggesting a coastal city. The print features fine, detailed lines that create texture and intricate details in architecture and human figures. The color palette is monochromatic with a contrast between dark lines and lighter spaces.

artworks.title: The Brook
artworks.medium: color monoprint with drypoint and softground etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image features two nude figures in an impressionistic style. Both bodies are depicted in their entirety, with one figure seated and the other standing beside. The seated figure is on a rocky surface with legs extended and leaning forward slightly, while the standing figure is positioned next to them, angled slightly sideways. Their facial features are indistinct, with soft outlines. The seated figure has brown hair, and the standing figure has reddish hair. They are not wearing any clothing or visible jewelry and are not holding any objects. The background is abstract with swirls of blue, white, and brown tones, suggesting an outdoor environment, possibly near water, but lacks specific details.

artworks.title: Springtime, New Orleans
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of George Biddle, 1974)
artworks.description: The image shows an interior scene with open shutters, a figure sitting at a desk, and a view of rooftops and church spires outside. The drawing depicts a shadowy room with slatted wooden shutters that open to reveal an urban scene with churches and tall spires in the background. Inside, there is a desk cluttered with bottles and a small stack of books. The overall composition includes strong contrasts between light and shadow, emphasizing the vertical elements of the shutters and the intricate details of the external structures.

artworks.title: Bolling's Dam, Petersburgh, Virginia
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1961)
artworks.description: The image shows Bolling's Dam in Petersburg, Virginia. The viewer is positioned slightly above the river, looking across the water cascading over the dam. Close to us, the river flows over rocks with subtle movements. To the right are rocks, vegetation, and trees. The horizon shows buildings, including a central industrial structure. The sky above is filled with clouds in soft strokes, conveying depth and atmosphere. The color palette consists of muted greens, earth tones, and grays.

artworks.title: Chon-Ca-Pe
artworks.artist: Albert Newsam, after Henry Inman, after Charles Bird King
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person with a solemn facial expression. They are adorned with a red headdress featuring upright feathers and face paint with red and turquoise lines and dots. The person wears a necklace with animal teeth or claws, a strand of blue beads, and a round medallion. They also have large, beaded earrings and a thick white fur or plush robe over their shoulders. In their hand, they hold an object resembling an arrow or a stylized weapon. The background is plain.

artworks.title: New York, 1931
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a rooftop view over an urban landscape. The viewer is positioned above street level, looking across buildings in a cityscape. There is no clear horizon line, as the architecture dominates the view. Close to us, two people sit at a round table on a rooftop terrace surrounded by planters filled with foliage. The buildings in the distance vary in height and architectural style, from modern skyscrapers to traditional structures, including one with a pointed roof. The etching technique used in the artwork features detailed linework and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving the image a vintage aesthetic that highlights the etching intricacy.

artworks.title: The "Home Sweet Home" Cottage, Easthampton
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a house surrounded by nature from a head-on, slightly lower perspective. The horizon is obscured by the dense foliage around the house. Tall trees cast shadows on the ground, and the house is covered in vines and mostly shaded. The illustration uses cross-hatching and precise line work, creating a textured effect. The color scheme is sepia and black, emphasizing the light and shadow contrast.

artworks.title: The Heart of Easthampton
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from an elevated straight-on point of view. The horizon aligns with the rooftops of various buildings including a windmill and a church-like structure. The artwork uses detailed line work, cross-hatching for texture, and a monochromatic color palette of sepia tones and black. The foreground is open, leading to intricate architecture and dense foliage in the background. A single figure stands near the center facing the buildings, wooden fences, and leafy trees.

artworks.title: The Jonathan Baker Farm
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The scene shows rolling fields leading towards farm buildings. The horizon line is high in the composition with trees and buildings. The etching technique creates fine, linear strokes for a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. The fields have detailed patterns and the buildings and trees add vertical elements to the horizontal view.

artworks.title: Portrait of Joseph Pennell
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched view of a person seen from behind, standing upright with their hands on a counter or table surface. The person has short, dark hair and is wearing a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a vest, and an apron tied around their waist. In front of the person are bottles or containers on the surface. The background features large windows letting in light, suggesting an indoor setting during the day. There are indeterminate shapes outside the windows and items nearby, possibly on shelving or another part of the workspace.

artworks.title: Mrs. Hassam Knitting (large)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person in a side profile, sitting on a cushioned chair with an armrest. The person's dark, tousled hair frames their face. They are wearing a loose robe or dress and holding a small object, possibly a book or paper. In the background, there is a lampshade, suggesting an indoor setting. The drawing is done in a sketch style with lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Lithographer
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The sketch shows a person at a desk, seen from the mid-torso up with their back turned. The individual is focused on the cluttered desk filled with papers and office items. They wear a simple shirt and have short dark hair. Vertical lines in the background suggest blinds or windows, adding depth to the room. Furniture elements like a chair are also visible.

artworks.title: North River
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a small dock area with various wooden structures and boats. The view is from an elevated perspective with the horizon line at the top, featuring water with larger ships in the distance. The brushstrokes and lines give the work a sketch-like quality, creating a rough texture. The color palette is monochromatic with soft beige for the background and dark charcoal strokes for details. The composition includes wooden docks, shed-like buildings, ships, and a distant shoreline, all depicted with minimalistic style.

artworks.title: The Broad Curtain
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in profile on a chair, reading a book. She is dressed in a gown, her hair styled away from her face. The room has drapes and a side table with a plant and a bowl.

artworks.title: Storm King
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water in the foreground, large hills or mountains in the background, and a steam-powered vessel emitting smoke on the horizon. The composition is divided by a horizon line, with the sky above and water below. The overall style uses a monochromatic palette of varying shades of gray, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The sky has soft, diffuse clouds, and the landforms in the distance blend seamlessly with the surrounding elements.

artworks.title: And from the Tree, We With Her Child Unbound
artworks.artist: Ferdinand Joubert, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in a dynamic scene. The drawing depicts an intense and dramatic moment where individuals are interacting in what appears to be a conflict or struggle. There is a sense of movement conveyed by the positions and actions of the figures. Various implements are held by the figures, suggesting a scene of battle or some form of confrontation. A heightened sense of tension and urgency is present, enhanced by the detailed line work that outlines the figures' expressions and gestures. The background is sparsely illustrated with outlines of structures, adding context to the setting.

artworks.title: Thomas Prince, A. M.
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black on laid paper mounted to gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a seated position. The man is facing forward with a neutral expression on his face. He has long, curly hair that extends past his shoulders. His facial features include a prominent nose and slightly arched eyebrows. He is wearing a dark, formal outfit with a white clerical band around his neck. The background consists of a plain, dark surface with an arched frame surrounding the portrait. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man. Beneath the image, there is text identifying the person as Thomas Prince with additional information in Latin.

artworks.title: Payta Kootha, a Shawnee Warrior
artworks.artist: Albert Newsam, after Henry Inman, after Charles Bird King
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Jefferson Patterson, 1979)
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person in a seated position, facing forward. The individual has high cheekbones, a defined nose, and eyes looking slightly to the side. A red stripe is painted across their left eye and cheek. They wear a red head wrap with an intricate pattern, dark blue clothing with a red shirt underneath, large hoop earrings, and a nose ring. The background is plain and off-white.

artworks.title: Stormy Weather
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a vast body of water with land in the distance. The horizon is low, emphasizing the expansive sky filled with dense clouds and some sunlight. The water and landforms are partially lit, with hills or mountains fading into the distance. The foreground shows dark ground, potentially grassy or barren. The color scheme is sepia, creating a soft and timeless atmosphere. The tones are smoothly blended with a focus on light and shadow.

artworks.title: Death and the Woodcutter, 4th plate  (La Mort et le bûcheron)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a woodland setting. One figure is sitting on the ground holding a bundle of sticks and a sickle, while the other is leaning against a tree with a scythe nearby. The forest environment is detailed with trees and foliage, depicted using intricate linework to show texture and depth. The drawing evokes a dramatic and intense mood through shading and line intensity. The level of detail in the drawing suggests technical skill and attention to realism.

artworks.title: Runcorn Bridge
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a river with a rowing stem bridge in the distance. The bridge, made of stone arches and iron truss sections, separates the sky from the water. The horizon is low with a vast sky dominating the composition in a light cream color. Near the viewer are rocks, planks, and remnants of industrial activity with smoke rising in the background. The style is precise with delicate lines, depicting a serene riverfront scene. A sailboat is on the river with its mast pointing upward. The artwork conveys calmness through hatching and minimal detail, creating a monochromatic feel.

artworks.title: Washington
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in three-quarter view. He has white hair, strong eyebrows, a prominent nose, and a firm mouth. He wears a dark coat over a white cravat. The background is plain. The image is labeled "Washington" with the artist's name in elegant script.

artworks.title: The Johnson Gate, Cambridge, Massachusetts
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1930)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with an ornate gate, leafless trees, and a building with a domed cupola in the background. The artwork features fine line work, intricate details, and a monochromatic sepia color palette. The street is depicted with cobblestones and sparse grass.

artworks.title: La rentrée du troupeau (The Return of the Flock)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The landscape is seen from an elevated point of view with a wide perspective. The horizon is low in the composition, with distant structures and rolling terrain. The brushstrokes are detailed, rendered in graphite or charcoal. The color palette is subdued, with soft greys and deep blacks. A flock of sheep is close by, with a figure, possibly a shepherd, and distant haystacks and a building.
